picks.what: The town during the Swedish siege of 1657, drawing
picks.why: only early view of the town itself; titled “Briestie Litepski … belagert und erobert”; trimmed to the town skyline, cutting the wide smoke-filled foreground and the torn paper corner

gaps: P0: nothing; P1: only the title page of the 1563 Brest Bible; P3: only an elevation and plan of the Augustinian church (1830); P4: nothing (all hits are Brest, France); P5: only the 1918 peace conference table
notes: #3 is a lower-resolution crop of the same Dahlbergh drawing; #5 is the later engraving with the siege in front. #4 is Brześć Kujawski, and #7–#9, #11–#15, #17–#20 are Brest in France or New York, so all excluded. Existing 2012 P6 view kept; #21 (night beach) and #22 (fortress path) are weaker.
